stemMarkdown: In a race of 100 m, the ratio of speeds of A and B is 7:4. If they start together, by what distance (in m) does A win when A finishes the race? (2 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: In the time A covers 100 m, B covers $\dfrac{4}{7} \times 100 = 57.14$ m (same time, speeds proportional to distance covered). A wins by $= 100 - 57.14 = 42.86$ m.
